# Notion

> Notion is an AI-powered all-in-one workspace that combines docs, projects, wikis, calendar, mail, and custom agents to streamline team collaboration and knowledge management.

Notion offers integrated productivity tools with enterprise-grade security and AI capabilities designed for teams of all sizes—from startups to Fortune 100 companies. The platform connects with 100+ external tools including Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub, and Figma to create unified workflows.

## Core Product & AI Features

- [The AI workspace that works for you](https://www.notion.com/product): Notion 3.0: AI workspace with custom agents, app search, and automation
- [Meet your AI team](https://www.notion.com/product/ai): Notion AI: search, generate, analyze, and chat within workspace
- [Meet your 24/7 AI team](https://www.notion.com/product/custom-agents): Custom Agents: 24/7 AI automation for recurring team workflows
- [AI Meeting Notes—Perfect meeting memory](https://www.notion.com/product/ai-meeting-notes): AI Meeting Notes: capture transcriptions, summaries, action items
- [Enterprise Search Software](https://www.notion.com/product/enterprise-search): Enterprise Search: AI-powered query across Slack, Drive, Jira
- [Notion AI Use Cases](https://www.notion.com/product/ai/use-cases): Notion AI use cases: automation examples, workflows, integrations

## Workspace Tools & Organization

- [Your connected workspace for wiki, docs & projects](https://www.notion.com/product/wikis): Notion Wikis: centralized knowledge management and documentation

- [Your connected workspace for wiki, docs & projects](https://www.notion.com/product/projects): Notion Projects: connected project management with task tracking

- [Notion Mail](https://www.notion.com/product/mail): Notion Mail: AI-powered inbox with auto-labeling and email management
